replies.author: D00ZiE
replies.body:
This would only be a verbal warning in game, so no action can be taken.

Do you have any more evidence?

replies.author: IcyCode
replies.body:
He clearly said kitpvp.com in game which is advertising. What other evidence would you need?
Rule quote A3:
  • Linking to content that promotes other Minecraft services. This includes, but is not limited to, other Minecraft servers and their corresponding websites and social media content that promotes other Minecraft servers.

replies.body:
No action will be taken.

He did not advertise, he just mentioned a server name.
 
This is only verbally warn-able offence.

Thanks for your concern.
